Summary: View available slots for a doctor
Description:
As a patient, I want to view available slots for a doctor so that I can pick a suitable time.
Given an open slot and a blocked slot, when a patient opens the schedule, then only the open slot can be selected.

Summary: Search for a doctor by specialty
Description:
As a patient, I want to search for a doctor by specialty so that I can find the right clinician.
Given specialists in multiple departments, when Cardiology is searched, then only matching active clinicians appear.

As a patient, I want to cancel my appointment so that I can release the slot.
Given a confirmed appointment within the cancellation policy, when the patient confirms cancellation, then status becomes Cancelled and the slot is available again.

As a patient, I want to see my cancellation confirmation so that I can verify that the booking ended.
Given a cancellation is saved, when the patient opens the appointment, then the cancellation timestamp and reference are visible.
As a doctor, I want to see my daily appointment list so that I can prepare for visits.

As a patient, I want to book an available slot so that I can secure an appointment.
Given another patient has taken a displayed slot, when booking is submitted, then no second appointment is created and fresh slots are offered. Given the slot is free, when a patient books it, then exactly one confirmed appointment is shown.
As a doctor, I want to reopen a blocked slot so that I can offer more availability.
As a patient, I want to turn off optional reminders so that I can control my messages.
As a patient, I want to choose email reminders so that I can receive notices on my preferred channel.

Summary: Move my appointment to another free slot
Description:
As a patient, I want to move my appointment to another free slot so that I can keep care when plans change.
Given an existing appointment and a free target slot, when the patient confirms a move, then the new slot is held and the old slot is released.

Summary: Receive a reminder a day before my appointment
Description: As a patient, I want to receive a reminder a day before my appointment so that I can attend on time.

Summary: Block a time on my schedule
Description: As a doctor, I want to block a time on my schedule so that I can reserve time for other duties.
